title: GL-08 — Application Load Balancer
stopChargesPanel: Delete the load balancer (this removes its listener) and wait, delete the target group, terminate the EC2 instance and wait, then disassociate and delete the route table, delete both subnets, detach and delete the internet gateway, and delete the security group and VPC.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on Application Load Balancer; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Accept cost risk
bullets: In the lab card, open the cost-risk box and type `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` exactly as shown.
Success: the UI records your confirmation before any hourly resource is created.
Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.

steps.title: Create VPC, subnets, IGW
bullets: Run `$VpcId = aws ec2 create-vpc --cidr-block 10.80.0.0/16 --query Vpc.VpcId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=vpc,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-08}]"`.

Run `$SubnetPub = aws ec2 create-subnet --vpc-id $VpcId --cidr-block 10.80.1.0/24 --availability-zone us-east-1a --query Subnet.SubnetId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=subnet,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-08}]"`.

Run `$SubnetPub2 = aws ec2 create-subnet --vpc-id $VpcId --cidr-block 10.80.2.0/24 --availability-zone us-east-1b --query Subnet.SubnetId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=subnet,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-08}]"`. An Application Load Balancer needs subnets in at least two Availability Zones.
Run `$IgwId = aws ec2 create-internet-gateway --query InternetGateway.InternetGatewayId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=internet-gateway,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-08}]"`.
Run `aws ec2 attach-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id $IgwId --vpc-id $VpcId`.
Run `$PublicRouteTableId = aws ec2 create-route-table --vpc-id $VpcId --query RouteTable.RouteTableId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=route-table,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-08}]"`.
Run `aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id $PublicRouteTableId --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --gateway-id $IgwId`.
Run `$RtAssocPub = aws ec2 associate-route-table --route-table-id $PublicRouteTableId --subnet-id $SubnetPub --query AssociationId --output text`.
Run `$RtAssocPub2 = aws ec2 associate-route-table --route-table-id $PublicRouteTableId --subnet-id $SubnetPub2 --query AssociationId --output text`.
Success: both public subnets (us-east-1a and us-east-1b) are associated with the route table that has the internet route.

steps.title: Security group
bullets: Run `$SgId = aws ec2 create-security-group --group-name workbook-gl08 --description gl08 --vpc-id $VpcId --query GroupId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=security-group,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-08}]"`.
Run `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id $SgId --protocol tcp --port 80 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0`.
Success: `$SgId` allows HTTP.

steps.title: Launch target instance
bullets: Run `$AmiId = aws ssm get-parameters --names /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64 --query "Parameters[0].Value" --output text`.

Run `$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\user-data.sh", "#!/bin/bash`npython3 -m http.server 80`n", $utf8)`. This writes LF line endings and no BOM, so the shebang works on Linux.

Run `$InstanceId = aws ec2 run-instances --image-id $AmiId --instance-type t3.micro --subnet-id $SubnetPub --security-group-ids $SgId --tag-specifications "ResourceType=instance,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-08}]" --user-data file://user-data.sh --query "Instances[0].InstanceId" --output text`.
Run `aws ec2 wait instance-running --instance-ids $InstanceId`.
Success: instance is running.

steps.title: Create ALB and target group
bullets: Run `$AlbArn = aws elbv2 create-load-balancer --name workbook-gl08 --subnets $SubnetPub $SubnetPub2 --security-groups $SgId --query "LoadBalancers[0].LoadBalancerArn" --output text --tags Key=LabId,Value=gl-08 Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab`.

Run `$TargetGroupArn = aws elbv2 create-target-group --name workbook-gl08-tg --protocol HTTP --port 80 --vpc-id $VpcId --target-type instance --query "TargetGroups[0].TargetGroupArn" --output text --tags Key=LabId,Value=gl-08 Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab`.
Run `aws elbv2 register-targets --target-group-arn $TargetGroupArn --targets Id=$InstanceId`.
Run `aws elbv2 create-listener --load-balancer-arn $AlbArn --protocol HTTP --port 80 --default-actions Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=$TargetGroupArn`.

Run `aws elbv2 wait target-in-service --target-group-arn $TargetGroupArn --targets Id=$InstanceId`. It checks every 15 seconds for up to 10 minutes; the default health check needs 5 passes 30 seconds apart, so expect about 2.5 minutes.
Success: the wait returns with no error, so the target is healthy.

steps.title: HTTP check
bullets: Run `$Dns = aws elbv2 describe-load-balancers --load-balancer-arns $AlbArn --query 'LoadBalancers[0].DNSName' --output text`.
Run `curl.exe http://$Dns/`. In Windows PowerShell 5.1, plain `curl` is an alias for Invoke-WebRequest, so type `curl.exe`.
Success: HTTP response from the instance.

steps.title: Confirm hourly cleanup plan
bullets: ALB and EC2 bill hourly; teardown deletes the ALB and waits, then the target group, then the instance, then the VPC stack.
Success: Stop charges order matches your resource ids.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Confirm you typed `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` in the card before any hourly create.
Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Stopping an instance or scaling to zero is not teardown.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: ALB (wait until deleted; its listener goes with it), target group, instance (wait until terminated), both route-table associations, route table, both subnets, internet gateway, security group, VPC
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-08` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: if ($AlbArn) { aws elbv2 delete-load-balancer --load-balancer-arn $AlbArn; aws elbv2 wait load-balancers-deleted --load-balancer-arns $AlbArn }
if ($InstanceId) { aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids $InstanceId; aws ec2 wait instance-terminated --instance-ids $InstanceId }
if ($IgwId -and $VpcId) { aws ec2 detach-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id $IgwId --vpc-id $VpcId; aws ec2 delete-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id $IgwId }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-08 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-08 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-08. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources. The ALB's network interfaces can linger for a minute or two after the delete waiter returns. If a subnet, internet gateway, or security group delete returns DependencyViolation, wait 1–2 minutes and rerun Stop charges from that line.

body: Internet-facing ALB with one healthy t3.micro target on HTTP. Delete all hourly components same session.
